items.title: 1.10 Wi-Fi security aur router configuration (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Wi-Fi security and router configuration (PDF 17).

blocks.text: Wi-Fi security network ko be-ijazat rasai se bachati hai. Is ke baghair qareeb ka koi bhi Internet connection use kar sakta hai, aur hackers ghair-mehfooz network se zaati maloomat chura sakte hain. Wi-Fi mehfooz karna data ko mehfooz aur raaz mein rakhta, aur bahar walon ko connection istemal kar ke sust karne se bhi rokta hai.

items: Router configuration: router ka web interface web browser mein router ka IP address likh kar khulta hai; login ke liye username aur password chahiye. Is se Wi-Fi ka naam aur password badla aur security settings control ki jati hain.

Wi-Fi encryption: network par bheje data ko mehfooz shakal mein badal kar bachati hai. WPA2 aur WPA3 aam security protocols hain; WEP jaise purane mehfooz nahi. Hamesha dastiyab sab se naya encryption tareeqa chunein.

Default gateway: woh device, aam taur par router, jo local network ko doosre networks se jorta hai. Bahar ke networks ke liye data gateway se guzarta hai, jo use sahi network ki taraf bhejta hai; Internet ki rasai is ki sahi setting par munhasir hai.

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Kam az kam aath characters ka mazboot namoona password banayein jis mein huroof aur numbers mile hon.

blocks.title: Lambe passwords zyada mazboot hain
blocks.text: Activity ke liye kitab ka kam az kam aath characters hai. Aaj ki rehnumai lambe passwords ya passphrases, taqreeban 12 ya zyada characters, chhote bare huroof, numbers aur symbols mila kar, pasand karti hai, aur router ka default password kabhi dobara use na karein.

Guest network mehmanon ko Internet use karne deta hai lekin unhein ghar ke asal network se alag rakhta hai, is liye mehman zaati devices tak nahi pohanch sakte. Is se hifazat aur raazdari barhti, Internet ka istemal control hota, aur yeh gharon aur daftaron mein mufeed hai.

blocks.prompt: WEP ke bajaye WPA2 ya WPA3 kyun chunna chahiye?
blocks.explanation: WEP purana protocol hai jo ab mehfooz nahi; WPA2 aur WPA3 mazboot encryption use karte hain, is liye Wi-Fi par bheja data asani se churaya nahi ja sakta.
Woh device (aam taur par router) jis ke zariye local network doosre networks, jaise Internet, ko data bhejta hai.

items: Wi-Fi security be-ijazat istemal aur data chori rokti.
Router web interface: Wi-Fi naam, password aur security settings badlein.
WPA2/WPA3 use karein, WEP nahi; router default gateway hai; mehmanon ko guest network.
